groupings.title: Product and planning
groupings.description: Turn a problem into a PRD, a PRD into an implementation-ready plan, and settle the open questions with research or a spike before anyone writes code.

groupings.title: Delivery
groupings.description: Execute a plan through implementation, commit, and pull request, either step by step or as one autonomous workstream.

groupings.title: Review and triage
groupings.description: Review a pull request through specialist agents, find the root cause of a bug, and dispose of incoming contributor work.

groupings.title: Orchestration and workspace
groupings.description: Run parallel workstreams in isolated git worktrees and see what work is open.

groupings.title: Authoring
groupings.description: Write the skills and the documentation themselves, and get a plain-language restatement when a reply does not land.
